source.attribution: Fictional demo card created for Mahjong IQ. Not an official National Mah Jongg League card.
source.notes: Category names follow common card conventions, but every hand below is invented for training purposes. Load a legitimately obtained card definition to practise the real annual card.

categories.description: Hands built from the digits of the year. White Dragon (Soap) stands for zero.
Only even numbers (2, 4, 6, 8), sometimes with Flowers or Dragons.

categories.name: Like Numbers
categories.description: The same number repeated in different suits.

categories.name: Quints
categories.description: Groups of five identical tiles. Every quint needs at least one Joker (except Flowers).

categories.name: Consecutive Runs
categories.description: Numbers in a row (e.g. 3-4-5). Any starting number that keeps the run within 1–9.

categories.name: Winds & Dragons
categories.description: Built mostly or entirely from Winds and Dragons.

categories.name: Singles & Pairs
categories.description: Concealed hands made only of singles and pairs — no Jokers can be used.
